learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 35 products, 90 variants (29 pre-roll products, 6 vapes). Wholesale storefront ('intended for resale only') with a CA and a NY OCM licence in the footer; the catalog is not split by state.
notes: product_type and tags are empty; the title is the strain, and the size is the variant: '1 gram Pre-Roll', '5 x 0.5 gram Pre-Rolls', '14 x 0.5 gram Pre-Rolls'. sizes.py reads '5 x 0.5 gram' as 0.5g (its pack-times-unit pattern wants a bare 'g'), so each pre-roll rule extracts '5 x 0.5 g' from the variant, which it reads as 2.5g.

Lines exist only as collections (/collections/<handle>/products.json). Bubble Hash Infused titles are the crosses 'Flower x Hash' (all six have ' x ', no other product does). Triple Infused has no mark in title or tags, and only two bodies say it, so the six are listed by handle (collection triple-infused on 2026-10-05); a new triple-infused product falls back to the body test, else reads as a plain strain pre-roll.
'Mule Fuel Flower rolled x Acapulco Gold' is named 'Mule Fuel x Acapulco Gold' (a constant), the way NY stores write it; the filler 'Flower rolled' made it miss them.
The six vapes (collection extracts, 'Default Title' variant) state no size anywhere on the site, and no NY store sells them at 2+ stores, so they are skipped rather than given an invented size.
Not on the site but sold by NY stores (2026-10-05): Alien OG and an effect series (Balance, Blended Uplift, Chill), all 1g pre-rolls. They come from the stores' consensus.
